outcome: Breastfeeding initiation within 2 hours after birth
Breastfeeding problems (perceived insufficient milk supply, breastfeeding pain)
cohort: Mothers in selected Polish maternity wards between March 2019 and November 2019
finding: While there was no correlation between mode of delivery and infant feeding method, knowledge of breastfeeding benefits and received support positively influenced the mother's decision to breastfeed, and exclusive breastfeeding was more common among mothers with higher education.
mod_finding: The study found no correlation between mode of delivery and the mother's choice of infant feeding method.
